messages:
mike: Heads up — proposal to migrate console telemetry from the current polymorphic event_payload JSON blob to a typed envelope model. sketch: add event_type + v2_payload columns, deprecate event_payload slowly.
anna: +1. can you paste the schema diff? small PR would help.
mike: sure, rough DDL:

ALTER TABLE telemetry_events
  ADD COLUMN event_type text,
  ADD COLUMN v2_payload jsonb,
  ALTER COLUMN event_payload SET DATA TYPE jsonb;

then write a compatibility view telemetry_events_view that normalizes both.
kevin: question: do we need a migration backfill? some consumers read raw event_payload today.
jamie: we do. plan: producers shadow-write both fields for 2 weeks, consumers read from view and migrate.
kevin: ok. what's the size estimate for the backfill? could hit the analytics DB.
mike: estimate ~600M rows, avg 1.2 KB -> ~720GB scanned. need staged backfill, rate-limited.
elaine: we should avoid a full-table rewrite. propose shadow-write + read-path gate using feature flag.
sahil: agree. steps I'd do: add event_type and v2_payload nullable; change producer lib to write both; introduce telemetry_events_view with COALESCE semantics; incremental backfill by partition/date; once consumers migrated and flag off, drop legacy column.
anna: timeline?
mike: tentative: producer change + flag rollout (1 week), view deploy (1 day), consumer updates (2 weeks), backfill (rolling over 3 weeks), final cutover (1 day).
jamie: add monitoring: daily count where event_type IS NULL, consumer errors by read-path. dashboard tile required.
elaine: also add slow-query alert for the view if p95 > 200ms.
kevin: what about retention? compress v2_payload or apply column-level compression?
mike: rely on jsonb + TOAST; but let's also store compact typed fields and move heavy free-text blobs to object store with payload_ref.
sahil: suggestion: put big text blobs (user prompt, stack traces) into S3 and keep payload_ref in v2_payload so queries stay small.
anna: helps queries, but adds read complexity. consumers need fetch logic.
jamie: the view can avoid fetching blobs for console routes; analytics jobs can do batch fetches.
kevin: will we version the envelope? add envelope_version to avoid future breaks.
mike: yes — event_type, envelope_version (int), v2_payload.
elaine: compatibility SQL for the view:

CREATE VIEW telemetry_events_view AS
SELECT
  id,
  COALESCE(event_type, (event_payload->>'type')) as event_type,
  CASE WHEN v2_payload IS NOT NULL THEN v2_payload ELSE jsonb_build_object('legacy', event_payload) END as normalized_payload,
  envelope_version
FROM telemetry_events;

kevin: will downstream materialized views break? need list of consumers.
mike: action: each consumer owner to comment on PR with migration plan.
anna: can we automate owner discovery? check infra catalog tags.
jamie: also add sample fixtures in redwood-telemetry/test-fixtures and update contract tests.
sahil: note: billing uses event_kind inside event_payload. billing pipeline must switch to event_type during the window.
mike: noted — billing team @elaine please coordinate.
elaine: will schedule short sync with billing and metering owners.
mike: risks: read-amplification on view, backfill load, subtle consumer parsing bugs. mitigations: staggered rollout, dark writes, canary queries.
anna: can we dogfood in staging? shadow writes in staging and run subset backfill.
kevin: yes but ensure no PII leaks to S3 when moving blobs.
jamie: add a PII scrubber step in backfill job.
sahil: backfill plan: process partitions per-day, concurrency 4 workers, rate-limit by RPS and bytes/s, resume token per partition.
mike: put backfill job in batch/telemetry/backfill_v2 repo; include safety checks (row count drift <0.1%).
elaine: dashboard needs: percent rows migrated, errors, view p95, billing token delta.
anna: automatic rollback if view p95 > 500ms for >10 minutes?
mike: yes, feature flag to switch read path back to legacy. add ops runbook ops/rollbacks/telemetry_v2.md.
kevin: add integration test asserting telemetry_events_view returns same event_type for recent writes.
jamie: will add to contract tests.
mike: final: I'll open PR with DDL + view + producer change draft. owners: @anna (consumer gating), @kevin (backfill runner), @jamie (tests + dashboards), @elaine (billing + compliance), @sahil (storage refactor).
anna: 👍
kevin: starting backfill scheduler template.
jamie: adding dashboard tiles to console-ops folder.
elaine: booking sync tomorrow 10am PT.
deploy-bot: mike updated deploy intent for telemetry-schema-v2 (draft) — CI checks pending 🤖
mike: thanks — will post PR link when ready.
